project_title: BreachRadar AI - Threat Intelligence & Compromise Investigation Dashboard

theme.primary_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL COMMAND CENTER

scale.body_text: text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-300 text-slate-700
scale.caption: text-xs font-mono tracking-wider uppercase

grid_structure.history_drawer: fixed or slide-over panel on left/right

key_components.name: Investigation Header & Keyword Bar
features: Search input with support for Email, Domain, or Username detection
Quick target type selector pills (Email / Domain / Username / Auto-Detect)
Pulse scanning button with loading spinner & sound/vibration toggle indicator
Demo preset buttons (e.g. 'test@example.com', 'adobe.com', 'admin_root') for quick 1-click testing

key_components.name: Compromise Score Gauge Meter
features: Radial or semi-circle gauge (0 to 100 score) with color transition (Green -> Yellow -> Orange -> Red)
Pulsing status badge ('Critical Risk', 'High Risk', 'Moderate Risk', 'Clean')
Key risk indicators breakdown: Total Breaches, Exposed Passwords count, Data Classes count, First/Latest breach date

key_components.name: LLM AI Risk Report Panel
features: Streaming response animation simulating real-time AI security intelligence analysis
Threat Level Badge with animated pulse beacon
Executive Threat Summary text formatted in structured markdown style
Attack Vectors & Data Exposure analysis breakdown
Actionable Security Recommendations list with checkable remediation steps
Export Report button (JSON / Text / PDF preview modal)

key_components.name: Breach Results Table
features: Interactive filter tabs (All, Critical, High, Passwords Exposed, Verified Only)
Column headers: Breach Source/Name, Date, Exposed Data Classes, Compromise Severity, Action
Badges for data classes (e.g. Passwords, IP Addresses, Credit Cards, SSN, Emails)
Expandable row detail drawer with breach full description, logo icon, and leak vectors
Search within breach results table & sort by date/severity

key_components.name: Investigation History Sidebar/Modal
features: Chronological history list of conducted investigations stored in local storage
Quick reload keyword button & breach count badge
Clear history & export history tools

key_components.name: Empty & Loading State Radar Scan
features: Tactical radar pulse sweep animation while investigation is in progress
Zero-state security banner with search prompt instructions

motion_and_effects.radar_scan_animation: relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-transparent before:via-cyan-500/20 before:to-transparent before:animate-pulse

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a sleek, high-density enterprise security dashboard in React with Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.

Integrate free real breach data APIs (e.g., HaveIBeenPwned public API endpoints, leak-lookup, or fallback robust simulated real-world leak database with 50+ detailed breach records like HaveIBeenPwned, Canva, LinkedIn, Wattpad, Chegg, Deezer, Evite, MySpace, Zynga, T-Mobile, etc. when rate limited or offline).
Use FastAPI / OpenAI or local LLM proxy endpoint on the backend to generate dynamic streaming AI risk report analyses based on detected breach data.
Ensure dark mode is the primary default theme, with a smooth toggle switch for light mode.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to ALL buttons, inputs, tables, gauges, and interactive cards for testing compliance.
Avoid generic unstyled UI. Use glowing status indicators, crisp font pairings (Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono), and micro-animations on search and table interactions.
